vision: Enable operations teams to react instantly to system incidents through real-time notifications integrated with existing tools, ensuring SLA compliance and minimizing downtime.
scope: Develop microservice-based real-time incident notification system integrated with PagerDuty and Slack, ensuring <500ms latency and SLA timers visibility for ops teams within a 2-week sprint.
success_criteria: Notifications delivered to Slack and PagerDuty within 500ms of incident detection
SLA timers automatically started and visible to ops teams

user_stories.title: Real-time incident notification delivery across Slack and PagerDuty within 500ms latency
user_stories.i_want: to receive real-time incident notifications in Slack and PagerDuty within 500ms
user_stories.so_that: I can respond to issues immediately and prevent SLA breaches

acceptance_criteria.given: an incident is detected by the monitoring service
acceptance_criteria.then: Slack and PagerDuty receive the alert within 500ms

user_stories.title: Automatic SLA timer initiation upon incident detection
user_stories.i_want: SLA timers to start automatically when an incident is reported
user_stories.so_that: I can track response times and ensure compliance with SLAs

acceptance_criteria.when: the SLA service receives incident details
acceptance_criteria.then: an SLA timer is initialized and displayed to ops team members

user_stories.title: Microservice health and failure recovery tracking for notification pipeline
user_stories.i_want: to monitor microservices health and ensure automatic recovery for the notification pipeline
user_stories.so_that: incident alerts remain reliable and uninterrupted

acceptance_criteria.given: the notification microservice experiences an outage
acceptance_criteria.when: failure detection triggers a recovery process
acceptance_criteria.then: service is restarted and queued notifications are processed without loss
